name: rich-link
description: Long answers as mobile-friendly HTML pages: shortlinks mini-app + rich-link skill.
env_example: # Base URL used when composing shareable links.
# Set when the platform is published through a reverse proxy/tunnel.
post_install: The shortlinks mini-app hot-loads at /api/shortlinks/ (verify via /api/catalog).
Pages are stored under the data volume (shortlinks/); serve them from PUBLIC_BASE_URL when exposing externally.
Only expose /api/shortlinks/p/* through any reverse proxy — never the admin endpoints.
